# Knack

No-code database and business application platform for building custom web apps without coding.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/knack/.

## Actions

- **Create object record**: Create a new record in a specific Knack object.
- **Delete Object Record**: Delete a single record from a specific Knack object by its ID.
- **Get Object Record** (read-only): Retrieve a single record by its ID from a specific Knack object.
- **List Object Records** (read-only): Retrieve multiple records from a specific Knack object (table).
- **List View Records** (read-only): Retrieve multiple records from a specific Knack view (tables, lists, searches, calendars).
- **Update object record**: Update an existing record in a specific Knack object.
- **Create View Record**: Create a new record through a form view in Knack.
- **Delete View Record**: Delete a record through a view that contains a delete link.
- **Upload File**: Upload a file to a Knack application.
- **Upload Image**: Upload an image to a Knack application.
